notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {R}.
description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guaridan enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Flameshadow Conjuring.
Holding priority, activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Felidar Guardian with haste.
The Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
